item.title: BOSE OUT. KICKER IN. Forever Z has a voice!
item.description: The Bose system is out, replaced by Kenwood DMX7706S, Maestro RR, KICKER KS components and rear fill, an NVX NDA11005 five-channel amplifier and a working KICKER L7S loaded 10-inch sub. Rated amp power is up to 1,100W RMS combined at specified loads, including a 500W RMS sub channel at 2 ohms.

item.title: The first real garage session
item.description: Hood up, hatch open and half the interior apart: Forever Z has officially moved from purchase mode into project mode. The audio rebuild is alive, the used sub failed testing, and the next engine-baseline parts are on the way.

item.title: Z1 order placed: plugs, hood hardware and the little stuff
item.description: Incoming: Z1 370Z hood struts, an OEM 2009–2022 hood-release lever, six Denso VQ37VHR spark plugs and a Z1 Motorsports decal set.

item.title: Stereo rebuild is alive — the used sub is not
item.description: The Kenwood and NVX five-channel amp are installed and operational, the Bose amp is bypassed and all four cabin speakers work. Channel 5 tested good, but the used KICKER loaded sub failed playback and a direct battery-pop test, so the return is underway.

item.title: CEL is off after the battery reset — diagnosis continues
item.description: The catalyst CEL is currently off after the battery disconnect, but readiness also reset. Spark plugs are next, followed by a normal drive cycle and rescan before cats or O2 sensors are condemned.

item.title: Engine history audit completed
item.description: The VIN-specific CARFAX was re-audited. No spark-plug or ignition-coil replacement is documented, so plugs move onto the baseline list while coils remain diagnosis-only.
